caseName: Federal Communications Commission v. Midwest Video Corp.
caseNameFull: Federal Communications Commission v. Midwest Video Corp. American Civil Liberties Union v. Federal Communications Commission and National Black Media Coalition v. Midwest Video Corp.

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. Motion of Consumers Union of the United States, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 571 F. 2d 1025.
